title: 第5章 叫我心肝宝
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

她离的很近。

近到能清楚闻到她身上淡淡的香味。

不像是喷了香水。

秦渡喉结滚动，脊背下意识绷紧，整个人僵硬的有些像木偶。

他想不起以前的事。

但如果赵楹月说的是真的。

他真的在和她谈恋爱的话。

那他们应该有过肢体接触才对。

可身体的下意识反应骗不了人。

难道……

秦渡不禁想起上次赵楹月说他是渣男的话，陷入沉思。

“好了！”

拍完照的赵楹月立即松开手，低头摆弄着照片。

照片里只有她露了脸。

建模漂亮，原相机也很能抗，几乎没有需要p的地方。

发布朋友圈的时候，赵楹月特地屏蔽了家人。

唯独‘忘记’了屏蔽赵随野的助理，海薇。

她笃定，海薇一定会原封不动的截图给赵随野。

这才是她要制造的效果。

确认，发送！

然后美美坐等丰收成果。

“月、赵楹月。”

忽然，秦渡不自在的开口。

本来是想亲密的叫月月，可话到了嘴边，不知怎的如此拗口。

便改口叫了全名。

赵楹月认真的抬眼看他。

然后作出一副受伤状捧心，胡话张口就来：“宝宝，你以前都是叫我心肝宝的。”

宁南、李刚、范鸽同时起了一身鸡皮疙瘩：“……”

退退退！

妖魔鬼怪快从他们老大身上下去！

秦渡：“……”

他嘴角抽搐，对赵楹月口中的心肝宝，表示出了强烈的抗拒。

就跟抗拒他叫铁牛一样！

秦渡深呼吸了一口气，再次喊：“赵楹月。”

赵楹月瞪他，“都说了叫人家心肝宝！”

她今天还就和心肝宝杠上了。

要是哪天见了她哥，还直呼她的大名，那不就露馅了吗？

为了一辈子的荣华富贵，赵楹月决不允许这样的情况出现。

所以，在执行下一步计划前。

必须要好好调教调教这个黄毛。

反正他失忆了，可以让她尽情发挥。

“赵楹月。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

She was very close.

Close enough to clearly smell the faint fragrance of her body.

It's not like wearing perfume.

Qin Du's Adam's apple rolled, his back subconsciously tightened, and his whole body was as stiff as a puppet.

He couldn't remember what happened before.

But if what Zhao Yingyue said is true.

If he is really in love with her.

Then they should have had physical contact.

But the body’s subconscious reactions cannot fool anyone.

Could it be...

Qin Du couldn't help but think of what Zhao Yingyue said last time about him being a scumbag, and fell into deep thought.

"Okay!"

After taking the photo, Zhao Yingyue immediately let go of her hand and lowered her head to fiddle with the photo.

She was the only one showing her face in the photo.

The modeling is beautiful, the original camera is also very capable, and there is almost no need for photoshop.

When posting on Moments, Zhao Yingyue specifically blocked her family members.

The only one who 'forgot' was Haiwei, the assistant who blocked Zhao Suiye.

She was sure that Haiwei would give the screenshots intact to Zhao Suiye.

This is the effect she wants to create.

Confirm and send!

Then Meimei sits back and waits for the harvest.

"Yue, Zhao Yingyue."

Suddenly, Qin Du spoke uncomfortably.

Originally, she wanted to be intimate and call her Yueyue, but when the words came to her lips, it was so awkward for some reason.

Then he changed his name to his full name.

Zhao Yingyue looked up at him seriously.

Then he pretended to be hurt and said nonsense: "Baby, you used to call me my sweetheart."

Ning Nan, Li Gang, and Fan Ge all had goosebumps at the same time: "..."

Back, back, back!

Monsters and monsters, get off their boss!

Qin Du: "..."

The corner of his mouth twitched, showing strong resistance to the treasure Zhao Yingyue said.

It's like resisting him being called Iron Bull!

Qin Du took a deep breath and called out again: "Zhao Yingyue."

Zhao Yingyue glared at him, "I told you to call me your darling!"

She even had sex with her sweetheart today.

If one day he met her brother and he called her by his first name, wouldn't that reveal his secret?

For the sake of a lifetime of glory and wealth, Zhao Yingyue would never allow such a situation to occur.

So, before executing the next step.

This yellow hair must be properly trained and trained.

Anyway, since he has amnesia, he can let her do whatever she wants.

"Zhao Yingyue."
